title: The Geometric Function Atlas: Using What We Know About Radius Problems to Solve New Ones
summary: Usually, radius problems between Ma--Minda classes are solved one pair at a time, by fitting a disk inside the target region, providing a sufficient but not always the sharp radius. The same class appearing under different names makes comparison of results harder, with mistakes and duplication eluding detection. The Geometric Function Atlas catalogs radius problems using exact generators and a direction (source $\to$ target), ensuring unique identification.
